name: Mohanraaj Govindaswamy
bio: CTO at Touchmark Descience. Opened Open Source Fridays with Episode 1: raw conversations, code tear-downs and insights instead of theoretical lectures.
notes: Bio from the Ep 1 title only; the Ep 1 description has no detail. Company is written 'Touchmark Descience' here and 'Touchmark Descience Pvt Ltd' on Ep 8-9.

name: Ariyappan P
bio: Product Engineer at OriginBI Mindworks Pvt Ltd. Ran a three-part series on GPUs for AI: what GPUs actually do in modern AI apps and how to pick one for a project, then a live build of a face detection and recognition app on Jarvis Lab GPUs with RetinaFace and ArcFace, and a code walkthrough of that build.
notes: Owner confirmed 'Ariyappan P' and 'Ariyappan' are one person, at OriginBI Mindworks Pvt Ltd (2 Nov).

name: Sathya Prakash Sekaran
bio: Director - HR at Ziffity Solutions. Shared the leadership and performance skills industry leaders look for in the AI era, and how to navigate career growth.

name: Rajesh Kanna
bio: Lead Data Engineer at EPAM Systems. Showed, in live code, how scalable, high-volume data pipelines are designed and built in the cloud: ingestion, transformation with PySpark, and cloud-native architecture.

name: Padmanaban Varatharajan
bio: Works in lab informatics at Sanofi. Explained how laboratory information management systems (LIMS), lab execution systems (LES) and automation drive healthcare, pharmaceuticals and manufacturing, and what it takes to build a career in that niche.
notes: CHECK: the episode record says 'Sr. DevOps – Sample Manager, Sanofi India (Hyderabad)' but the Ep 7 description says 'Configuration Expert LUNA at Sanofi'. Which title is current?

name: Bharathiraja Thangappalam
bio: CEO of Touchmark Descience Pvt Ltd. Joined a two-part open-mic talk show on what businesses really prioritise when hiring, why traditional resumes fail to stand out, and where uncrowded market opportunities are emerging.

name: Karthikeyan Natarajan
bio: VP, Operations at OriginBI Mindworks Pvt. Ltd. Ran two sessions for students thinking beyond placements: how to think like a founder while in college, find and validate startup ideas, avoid common first-time founder mistakes, and build a long-term venture of their own.
notes: Company is written 'OriginBI Mindworks Pvt. Ltd.' here and 'OriginBI Mindworks Pvt Ltd' for Ariyappan. Pick one spelling.

name: Jayaprakash Natarajan
bio: CEO of CubeAI Solutions Tech. Gave a slide-free technical breakdown of autonomous AI agents: agent orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, enterprise system design, and LLM red teaming and security.
notes: Live name is 'Dr. Jayaprakash Natarajan, PhD'; stored as honorific 'Dr.' + name.

name: Arumugam V
bio: Principal Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments, with over a decade of hands-on enterprise engineering experience. Came back by popular demand: first on how code really reaches production through the SDLC and modern DevOps, then on how Agile actually works on large global technology platforms.
notes: Company confirmed by owner (2 Nov) and stated in the Ep 13-14 descriptions.

name: Selvaganapathi Ramachandran
bio: Delivery Lead at HCLTech and an Executive COO alumnus of IIM Lucknow, with 15+ years of R&D engineering leadership across HCLTech, Valeo and Mahindra. Covered niche, high-growth domains such as PLM, digital manufacturing and model-based systems, then a resume masterclass on getting past HR rejections.
